name: Hoành Bồ guava
summary: Ổi Hoành Bồ is a local Hạ Long product Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh names beside xôi chả mực. At the opening of phố đi bộ Bài Thơ the stall sold it in bags of about 5 kg and up, and the article questioned the fruit.
origin: Hạ Long, named by Chuyên trang du lịch Quảng Ninh as a local specialty. Hoành Bồ is the old district name in that article.
howToEat: Sold by the bag. The opening account says the bags were about 5 kg and larger. A ripe-or-cook instruction was not printed.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival. A current stall is Check on arrival.
where: Phố đi bộ Bài Thơ, at the opening the tourism article describes. The article does not give the stall a name.
seoTitle: Oi Hoanh Bo — the Ha Long guava
